description: Gate 1.5 / Gate 2.5 second-model Architect review. Provider- and model-AGNOSTIC: set any model id. Not coupled to OpenCode or Mimo. The reviewer is launched as a separate fresh-context sub-agent; scripts/dev/architect_review.py only builds context and ingests the findings.
launch_command: opencode run --agent {agent} --model {model} -f "{prompt_file}" "Perform the architect review in the attached file; output only the BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT/SUMMARY sections."
override: Per run: --model <id> or env PF_ARCHITECT_REVIEW_MODEL (takes precedence over this file).
